Whether TX-0401 can be disputed depends on the reason, and I need that from you first. Each reason code has its own eligibility rules, so I have to check against the one that matches what happened.

Which of these describes your situation?

- **Duplicate charge:** You were billed twice for the same purchase. TX-0401 and TX-0402 are both EUR 240.00 to TechMart Online, 6 days apart, so this could apply if you bought only one item.
- **Unauthorised debit:** You did not make or approve this payment.
- **Card-not-present fraud:** An online payment was made with your card details without your authorisation.
- **Goods not received:** You paid TechMart Online and did not receive the item.
- **Service not rendered:** You paid for a service that was not provided.

Once you tell me, I'll run the eligibility check and let you know the result. I won't open a dispute without your explicit confirmation.
